questions.solution:
Joules law,

\(\mathrm{H}=\mathrm{I}^{2} \mathrm{Rt}=\frac{\mathrm{V}^{2} \mathrm{t}}{\mathrm{R}}\)

Also,

\(\mathrm{R}=\rho \frac{1}{\mathrm{~A}} \Rightarrow \mathrm{R} \propto \frac{1}{\mathrm{~A}} \Rightarrow \mathrm{R} \propto \frac{1}{\mathrm{r}^{2}}\)

\(\therefore R^{\prime}=\frac{R}{4}\)

parallel \(\Rightarrow \mathrm{R}_{\mathrm{p}}=\left(\frac{1}{\mathrm{R} / 4}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{R} / 4}\right)^{-1}=\frac{\mathrm{R}}{8}\)

\(\text { series } \Rightarrow \mathrm{R}_{\mathrm{s}}=\frac{\mathrm{R}}{4}+\frac{\mathrm{R}}{4}=\frac{\mathrm{R}}{2}\)

\(\therefore \frac{\mathrm{V}^{2} 4}{\mathrm{R}}=\frac{\mathrm{V}^{2} \mathrm{t}_{\mathrm{p}}}{\mathrm{R}_{\mathrm{p}}}=\frac{\mathrm{V}^{2} \mathrm{t}_{\mathrm{s}}}{\mathrm{R}_\mathrm{s}}\)

\(\Rightarrow \mathrm{t}_{\mathrm{p}}=0.5 \mathrm{~min}, \mathrm{t}_{\mathrm{s}}=2 \mathrm{~min}\)

questions.q: Consider an elliptically shaped rail PQ in the vertical plane with OP = 3 m and OQ = 4 m . A block of mass 1 kg is pulled along the rail from P to Q with a force of 18 N, which is always parallel to line PQ (see the figure given).
